title: Ep 10 — Claude's invisible watermark, and the testimonial widget that hit a million a year
description: Anthropic begins invisibly watermarking Claude's text output for EU transparency rules, Google launches a cheaper, faster Gemini three point seven Flash for coding, and IBM strikes a formal enterprise partnership with OpenAI. Plus a deep dive on testimonial-widget tool Senja, which two co-founders grew from one hundred dollars a month to a million dollars a year, and a quiet week for the Fundraising Regulator's prize-draw ruling and EV-Partnerships.
